Definition: from the same as G2245; maturity (in years or size):--age, stature.
BiblicalUsage: Helikia means age, stature, the measure of a life, and Jesus uses it for both growing and worrying. In Luke 2:52 Jesus increases in wisdom and stature, in Luke 12:25 and Matthew 6:27 no man can add one cubit to his stature by taking thought, and in Ephesians 4:13 the church grows to the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word teaches me what I can grow and what I cannot: I can grow in wisdom as Jesus did, and I can grow into the stature of Christ, but worry adds nothing to my height. The growing that matters is the one God does.
